headline.title: Studio Pilates International Surry Hills, 2.5 km away, has 136 Google reviews. Studio Form & Flow has 122.
headline.detail: Your rating is 5.0, as high as or higher than theirs. The quality is there; the volume isn't yet. On a map, people comparing studios often pick the bigger number.

summary: Studio Form & Flow has 122 Google reviews at 5.0, and reviews praise classes matched to every level and a community people look forward to. We compared you with the 4 nearest independent studios, and the gap is not quality but how easily new members can find, trust and book you.
visibility: We compared Studio Form & Flow with the 4 nearest independent studios on Google Maps (ratings, review counts and opening hours as shown today).
lead: 122 Google reviews at 5.0: more than 3 of the 4 studios nearby we compared.
Reviews praise classes matched to every level and a community people look forward to.
Open on Sundays, when some nearby studios are closed.
lose: 1 of the 4 studios nearby has more reviews, up to 136 (Studio Pilates International Surry Hills).
Rapture Pilates is open until 8pm on weekdays; you close at 7:30pm.
New members who don't know you yet compare studios on a phone in seconds; without your own booking-ready page, your best reviews stay buried in the listing.

gaps.title: The comparison happens before anyone calls
gaps.detail: People choosing a studio look at the map, the review count and a website, then book wherever it's easiest. Being the best isn't enough if it isn't visible.

gaps.title: Your strongest story is hidden
gaps.detail: Reviews praise classes matched to every level and a community people look forward to. But someone new only sees a star rating, not why people love you.

gaps.title: Every class without a follow-up is a missed review
gaps.detail: Happy members rarely leave a review unless someone asks at the right moment. That's how bigger studios pull ahead.

actions.title: Get a page that turns visitors into bookings
actions.why: Your reviews, classes, hours and one-tap booking or WhatsApp on one fast page for phones.

actions.title: Ask every member for a review automatically
actions.why: A short message after each class; the quickest way to close the gap with studios that have more reviews.

actions.title: Reply to every new review this week
actions.why: Doable today, without us: it shows new visitors a real person who cares, and they notice.

plan.title: Your new website with booking built in
plan.detail: Your classes, team and reviews on one page, with one-tap booking or WhatsApp from any phone.

plan.title: Automatic review requests
plan.detail: A friendly message after each class, so happy members become five-star reviews.

plan.title: Offers and win-back messages
plan.detail: Intro offers for new members and gentle reminders for those who haven't booked in a while.

plan.title: Your first monthly report
plan.detail: Where you stand against the studios nearby, and what to do next.

scenario: Someone new to Glebe wants to book a class this week. On Sunday evening they open Maps, see a few studios and tap the one with the most reviews and an easy booking page. Studio Form & Flow, with 122 reviews at 5.0, is close by, but they never get past the listing. (Illustration.)
nochange: Your regular members keep coming back. New members keep choosing whichever studio looks easiest to book on their phone.
